text_block_list.text:
One day, Curren Chan decides to do an
interview
for a website as part of her
self-promotion
efforts. On the way to
the interview...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So actually... I've done an interview with
this
reporter before.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yep. That was back when I was
gathering
attention as an
Umastagrammer, though...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I want you to promise me something.
Don't stop
me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I want you to promise me something.
Don't stop
me, okay?

I realize what she means as soon as the
interview
begins...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
So just between you and me... Why did
you make
your racing debut?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
You're already quite well known on
Umastagram,
but I'm guessing you're
looking for even more
attention. Is that
right?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, am I wrong? Word on the online
street is that
you're getting into racing
"just for funsies."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
The truth is that you just want people to
talk
about you, right? Even if you don't
do well
running, you figure you'll still be
trending as long
as you're cute.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
You're so calculating! Crafty, even! I bet
you're
just acting in all those "training"
videos too,
right?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Your recent posts are just as flashy as
ever. Of
course no one's going to think
you're serious
about running like this.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
So what do you say? Why not tell
everyone how
you really feel? You're
sure to go viral, just like
you want.

This is going too far. Unable to keep
quiet, I try
to intervene, when...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Bro.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Sis.

Curren Chan stops me in my tracks with
a smile...
And then, she finally speaks up
herself.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: So, racing is definitely not just for "funsies"! I want to make that clear. ♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
My reason for racing is because of the
runners
who I admire.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's kind of a long story, but since there
seems to
be a misunderstanding, I'd like
to explain some
more.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Uh, okay. Sure...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
First of all, Tracen Academy isn't the
kind of
place you can get accepted to if
you're just
messing around.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Before I transferred, I saw plenty of
other girls
crying as they were forced to
give up. Entrance is
based on ability,
and coming to terms with the
reality of
your ability can be painful.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I've only just made my debut. I have no
idea
what's gonna happen from here. It's
possible that
I don't make any impact
whatsoever...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But I have to run. I absolutely have to.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: A-and why might that be?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because I say so. ♪ I've decided that I'm
gonna
win races and become the cutest
of all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna run away and make
excuses like "I
wasn't really serious
anyway."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I am very serious about this. I don't know what's waiting for me at the end of this road... but I hope everyone will be watching when I get there. ♪

Curren Chan continues to speak
sincerely about
the charm she's found in
racing, her new dreams,
her current
thoughts... and her future prospects.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I'll send you the article when it's
finished! Cute
Curren Chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I can't wait! Thank you so much! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Whew. How do you think I did?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehe... I actually kinda messed up the last
time he
interviewed me.
choice_data_list: 毅然としててカッコよかったよ
choice_data_list_en: You stood your ground, and it was so cool.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's kinda embarrassing, so promise not
to tell
anyone, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So you saw how blunt he is, right? I was
trying to
match his energy and ended up
accidentally
saying something I didn't
really mean.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I answered one of his questions with
"Sure, but..."
and then he cut out
everything except the "sure"
in the final
article. I couldn't believe I was so

careless!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But I learned a lot from that experience.
Just
going along with things smiling and
nodding
doesn't do the interviewer or
interviewee any
favors.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's why this time, I kept smiling but
was sure to
be clear and direct. ♪ I bet
no one'll
underestimate me again now!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But that guy's actually one of the better
ones,
believe it or not. Sooo many
reporters just write
articles without even
bothering to ask for an
interview.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Plus, this was a good opportunity for
me. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Some of the stuff he asked me actually
has been
going around online. People
really are saying that
I'm not taking
racing seriously.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But I'm hoping that will change once this
article
comes out.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm sure it will. After all... I was
speaking my
truth.

As Curren Chan predicted, her fans
share the
article once it's posted and her
feelings about
racing spread.

In the end, the article attracts more
attention
than the gossip that had been
spreading. Curren
Chan overcomes the
haters and ends up gaining
fans. Just as
she planned...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"#Welcome #NewFollowers
#CuteCurrenChan
#CheerForMe ♪"
